claims: An EGOT is the accomplishment of winning an Emmy, Grammy, Oscar, and Tony.
As of early 2026, only 22 people have achieved EGOT.
Richard Rodgers achieved EGOT in 1962.
Richard Rodgers was the first EGOT winner.
Rita Moreno achieved EGOT in 1977.
Helen Hayes achieved EGOT in 1977.
Rita Moreno and Helen Hayes were the first female EGOT winners.
Robert Lopez achieved EGOT in 2014.
Robert Lopez is the youngest EGOT winner.
Robert Lopez is the only person to win all four EGOT awards at least twice.
Whoopi Goldberg achieved EGOT in 2002.
John Legend achieved EGOT in 2018 alongside fellow Jesus Christ Superstar Live producers.
Jennifer Hudson achieved EGOT in 2022 as a producer for A Strange Loop.
Viola Davis achieved EGOT in 2023 with a Grammy for her memoir narration.
Elton John achieved EGOT in 2024 with an Emmy for his Dodger Stadium concert film.
Benj Pasek and Justin Paul achieved EGOT in 2024.
Benj Pasek and Justin Paul secured their Emmy in 2024.
Benj Pasek and Justin Paul are the songwriting team for La La Land and Dear Evan Hansen.
Steven Spielberg achieved EGOT in 2026 after winning his first Grammy for producing Music by John Williams.
Audrey Hepburn is an EGOT winner.
Mel Brooks is an EGOT winner.
Mike Nichols is an EGOT winner.
John Gielgud is an EGOT winner.
Philip Michael Thomas coined the term EGOT in 1984.
The term EGOT is associated with the show 30 Rock.
